name: Moonstone Archon Temple
introDiscord: A moonstone temple hums with vows older than recorded tides. Silver inscriptions glow beneath every step, guardian statues face the central halls, and someone has placed a tiny pebble hat on one of them.
introTwitch: A moonstone temple hums with vows older than recorded tides. Silver inscriptions glow beneath every step, guardian statues face the central halls, and someone has placed a tiny pebble hat on one of them.

votive-stair.prompt: Silver votive steps climb beneath guardian statues toward three temple doors. Moonstone inscriptions brighten underfoot while one statue wears a suspiciously jaunty pebble.

left.message: A Fae offering vessel rests between rows of proper ceremonial gifts. Beside them sits one obviously nonceremonial shiny rock. You suspect Shizuki. The vessel contains Star Candies.

right.message: A Moonstone Archon statue turns its head toward you. You stop. It stands. Apparently this temple has very active security.

forward.message: Shizuki's restorative reads: "Borrowed from an altar that looked underused. Left replacement offering: one excellent pebble."
forward.fullHpMessage: The borrowed altar restorative remains untouched. You are already at full health, so the excellent pebble may continue covering the debt.

archon-nave.prompt: Tall pillars divide the solemn nave into three routes. Every inscription requests silence. Somewhere behind you, a tiny stone falls over with an extremely loud clack.

left.message: One Berry rests behind Shizuki's folded note: "This place made me think too hard, so here is a snack. Philosophy postponed."

right.message: A Moonkeeper cache rests beneath a relief of ancient guardians. Opening it reveals Star Candies and does not summon divine judgment. Encouraging.

forward.message: A Moonstone Archon steps from between the pillars. It raises one hand, waits for you to leave, then visibly seems disappointed when you don't.

lunar-apse.prompt: The apse curves around a quiet moonstone altar. Three shadowed doors open behind it while faded offerings drift in the water.

left.message: One Archon kneels at the altar. When you approach, it rises with the painfully slow dignity of something that has been waiting centuries to do this.

right.message: Shizuki's bottle says: "I left an apology for borrowing the first one. It was almost sincere. This one is actually mine."
right.fullHpMessage: Shizuki's actually-her-own medicine remains sealed. At full health, no further temple apologies are required.

forward.message: A moon-shell coffer is hidden beneath the altar platform. You discover Star Candies and another pebble. Definitely Shizuki.

boss-antechamber.name: Hierophant Sanctum
boss-antechamber.prompt: The temple's oldest inscriptions circle a moonstone sanctum. Every guardian statue faces the central figure seated beyond the altar.

bossPromptDiscord:
The inscriptions across the entire temple light at once.

Every Archon kneels.

The central moonstone statue opens its eyes.

Use /yes to approach the Hierophant or /no to leave before the temple decides your pebble etiquette is unacceptable.
bossPromptTwitch:
The inscriptions across the entire temple light at once.

Every Archon kneels.

The central moonstone statue opens its eyes.

Use !yes to approach the Hierophant or !no to leave before the temple decides your pebble etiquette is unacceptable.
bossRetreatText: You leave the Hierophant Sanctum. The central statue closes its eyes, and the inscriptions return to their solemn glow.

boss.revealText: Moonstone radiance surrounds the central statue as it rises from the sanctum. The Moonstone Hierophant awakens!

completionText: The Moonstone Hierophant lowers its hands. The inscriptions dim, and every Archon returns to its post. As you leave, you notice the tiny pebble hat has somehow been placed back on the statue.
